title: Venus Tablet of Ammisaduqa (K.160)
summary: Neo-Assyrian cuneiform tablet, a later copy of observations of Venus attributed to the reign of Ammisaduqa. Chronological interpretations are disputed.
body: The tablet records Venus's first and last appearances over roughly twenty-one years. Because the observations are tied to a named king, the text has been used to anchor Mesopotamian chronology — and because the copy is late and the reading contested, the anchor is argued over rather than settled.
